paper_title: Search for light scalar Dark Matter candidate with AURIGA detector
notes: AURIGA resonant-mass detector searches for scalar 'moduli' DM in the band ~850-950 Hz (mphi ~ 3.5-3.9e-12 eV). The limit di <~ 1e-5 (95% C.L.) applies EQUALLY to both the electromagnetic gauge modulus d_e (ScalarPhoton, alpha variation) and the electron mass modulus d_me (ScalarElectron, m_e variation) since the strain depends on (d_me + d_e). The coupling type is genuinely ambiguous between ScalarPhoton and ScalarElectron; abstract emphasizes d_e. Only approximate level (~1e-5) given in text; the figure with the full curve (fig 5) is not numerically tabulated. rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed (SHM). | Auto-corrected masses: 1/(eV→MHz) i.e. MHz→eV inverse (×2.418e+08, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-03)|)
